questions.stem: A 45-year-old hypertensive patient is posted for laparoscopic cholecystectomy. He is on tablet telmisartan and tablet amlodipine. His BP in pre-operative area is 160/90 mm Hg. Which of these agents would not be preferred for induction of anaesthesia?
